newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil recovers late but closes down.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil recovers late but closes down.

text.p: IPE November gas oil closed down $2.00 a tonne at $223.50 on Thursday, having climbed back from lows of $219.50.
"It's a struggling recovery, a thin scramble and not the best version -- it didn't bounce particularly quickly after opening low," said one trader.
Little support was seen from Brent crude which at 1700 GMT was trading at $23.84 a barrel, down 23 cents.
Most of gas oil's volumes were concluded near the lows of the day and its late recovery owed a good deal to short-covering.
"It's not encourgaing for a bullish view," said a trader.
Dealers though Brent might still make up further ground, with $23.90 a barrel seen as a swing point dividing the morning trader from afternoon business.
"The night is young for Brent, but it's not a bandwagon to jump on," one trader said.

Although there was no dominant contract in the energy complex, gasoline was seen as the best performer. Good support was seen at 68.85 cents a gallon which NYMEX had broken, with November gasoline trading at 68.90 at 1700 GMT.
